items.title: Eddie Dawson Interview, 1961-06-28
items.q: The fellow that Brennan was there. Yeah, yeah, yeah. But Brennan was there having a good time, you know.

ctx.x: Was that uptown or downtown? Uptown, downtown.

That's the only fellas that I saw that would go in the house. That was, I don't know if you remember, Frank Landry? Yeah, Frank Landry. And you remember, Stael Brades? Stael Brades, yes. They used to keep running. Yeah, they'd go around. And Frank plays Marilyn. Marilyn and the... Yeah, Stael Brades plays guitar. Marilyn and the guitar. They'd sing, you know. They'd go in the house. Do you remember any of the other pianists? We were just talking about Fest being one of the great pianists in the district, but you might have been around there even a few years earlier than Fest. Do you remember any other pianists?
